text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
3,200 meters was long after all, and her 
legs felt heavy on the slope... Meisho 
Doto couldn't defeat T.M. Opera O.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her journey throughout this year would be 
long and arduous, just like this race. 
Meisho Doto vowed to desperately keep up 
with T.M. Opera O.
